tools.name: list_moldtelecom_services
tools.description: List the services Moldtelecom offers in the Republic of Moldova — fibre internet, IPTV television, mobile, fixed telephony and business services — each with the URL of its canonical page in the current language, plus the machine-readable site summaries. Read-only.

tools.name: search_moldtelecom_eshop
tools.description: Search the Magazin Online Moldtelecom device catalogue (phones, tablets, smartwatches, accessories) by free-text query. Returns each match with its brand, model, price in Moldovan lei (MDL), stock status and product page URL. Read-only: it never adds to a cart or places an order.

limit.description: How many results to return (1-24, default 8).
